title: OnRPG: 1M accounts breached
summary: In July 2016, the now defunct free online games list website OnRPG suffered a data breach that was later redistributed as part of a larger corpus of data. The incident exposed just over 1M email and IP addresses alongside usernames and passwords stored as salted MD5 hashes.

title: TehetségKapu: 54.4K accounts breached
summary: In March 2025, almost 55k records were breached from the Hungarian education office website TehetségKapu. The data was subsequently published to a popular hacking forum and included email addresses, names and usernames.
